import csv
from pathlib import Path

from directional_trial_protocol import REPO, TRIAL as ROOT, read, ref, save
from spatial_trial_protocol import read as read_any

evidence = REPO / "docs/results/v195-directional-response-v1"
images = REPO / "docs/images/v195-directional-response-v1"
report = REPO / "docs/directional-response-comparison.md"
assert not report.exists()
paired = read_any(ROOT / "paired-comparisons-v1.json.gz")
manifest = read(images / "manifest-v1.json")
plan = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
methods = paired["methods"]
labels = ["V183 EMA", "V187 EMA", "Whole raw", "Whole EMA", "Directional raw", "Directional EMA"]
assert len(methods) == len(labels) == 6
lookup = {(r["kind"], r["condition"], r["cohort"], r["field"]): r for r in paired["table_rows"]}
selected = [
    ("Mesh response (% GT) ↑", ("mesh", True, None, "template_gain"), 100),
    ("Mesh full RMS ↓", ("mesh", True, None, "full_error_RMS_DN16"), 1),
    ("Present-case blank RMS ↓", ("mesh", True, None, "blank_error_RMS_DN16"), 1),
    ("Absent-case full RMS ↓", ("mesh", False, None, "full_error_RMS_DN16"), 1),
    ("Quiet spatial RMS, ISO6400 ↓", ("mixed-quiet", "iso6400-prior", None, "quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16"), 1),
    ("Quiet spatial RMS, ISO12800 ↓", ("mixed-quiet", "iso12800-prior", None, "quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16"), 1),
    ("Fresh flat full RMS, ISO6400 ↓", ("flat", "iso6400-prior", "fresh-flat512", "full_error_RMS_DN16"), 1),
    ("Fresh flat full RMS, ISO12800 ↓", ("flat", "iso12800-prior", "fresh-flat512", "full_error_RMS_DN16"), 1),
    ("Fresh flat block32 RMS, ISO6400 ↓", ("flat", "iso6400-prior", "fresh-flat512", "block32_RMS_DN16"), 1),
    ("Fresh flat block32 RMS, ISO12800 ↓", ("flat", "iso12800-prior", "fresh-flat512", "block32_RMS_DN16"), 1),
    ("Retained photo faint band gain ↑", ("photo", "photo-faint", "retained512", "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain"), 1),
    ("Retained photo dark band gain ↑", ("photo", "photo-dark", "retained512", "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain"), 1),
    ("Organic photo faint band gain ↑", ("photo", "photo-faint", "organic384", "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain"), 1),
    ("Organic photo dark band gain ↑", ("photo", "photo-dark", "organic384", "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain"), 1),
]
lines = ["| Metric | Cases | " + " | ".join(labels) + " |", "| --- | ---: | " + " | ".join(["---:"] * 6) + " |"]
cells = []
for label, key, scale in selected:
    row = lookup[key]
    values = [format(row["values"][m] * scale, ".9g") for m in methods]
    lines.append("| " + label + " | " + str(row["cases"]) + " | " + " | ".join(values) + " |")
    cells.append({"label": label, "key": list(key), "scale": scale, "source": row, "displayed": values})
table = "\n".join(lines)
(ROOT / "report-core-table-v1.md").write_text(table + "\n")
with (evidence / "metrics-table-v1.csv").open("x", newline="") as stream:
    writer = csv.writer(stream)
    writer.writerow(["kind", "condition", "cohort", "field", "cases", *methods])
    for row in paired["table_rows"]:
        writer.writerow([row["kind"], row["condition"], row["cohort"], row["field"], row["cases"],
                         *[repr(row["values"][m]) for m in methods]])
directional = read(ROOT / "directional-breakdown-v2/result-v1.json")
context = [r for r in directional["previous_context_rows"] if r["method"] == "V187-pooled-wave-EMA"]
direction_rows = context + directional["rows"]
direction_lines = ["| Example | State | Whole (% GT) | Region A (% GT) | Region B (% GT) |",
                   "| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |"]
for seed in [2026112302, 2026112309]:
    case_id = f"mesh-seed{seed}-present-iso6400-prior-RGGB"
    for method in methods[1:]:
        row = next(r for r in direction_rows if r["id"] == case_id and r["method"] == method)
        values = [100 * row["whole_template_gain"], *[100 * s["gain"] for s in row["sectors"][:2]]]
        direction_lines.append(f"| {seed} | {labels[methods.index(method)]} | " + " | ".join(format(v, ".7f") for v in values) + " |")
direction_table = "\n".join(direction_lines)
(ROOT / "report-direction-table-v1.md").write_text(direction_table + "\n")
triplets = []
for method in methods[2:]:
    title = labels[methods.index(method)]
    triplets.append(f"**{title}: noisy → restored → exact constructed GT.**")
    for seed in [2026112302, 2026112309]:
        item = next(f for f in manifest["images"] if f["triplet"] and str(seed) in f["case"]["id"] and f["panels"][1]["label"] == method)
        triplets.append(f"![Mesh{seed}: noisy, {title}, exact GT](images/v195-directional-response-v1/{Path(item['image']['path']).name})")
triplets = "\n\n".join(triplets)
exports = read(ROOT / "exports-v1.json")["exports"]
checkpoint_lines = ["| State | Source checkpoint SHA256 | Module-state SHA256 |", "| --- | --- | --- |"]
for method in methods[2:]:
    entry = exports[method]
    checkpoint_lines.append(f"| {labels[methods.index(method)]} | `{entry['source_checkpoint']['sha256']}` | `{entry['module_hash']}` |")
checkpoint_table = "\n".join(checkpoint_lines)

text = f"""# Matched response pressure from V187 EMA (V195)

**Whole-response EMA is a useful stronger-response option:** mean constructed-mesh response rises **4.02% relative to V187 EMA**, from **5.359% to 5.575% of exact GT amplitude**. Quiet spatial RMS rises **0.334–0.376%**, worsening **30/32** quiet inputs. Real fine cab crossings and broad flat-field mottle remain unresolved. Keep this measured response gain and its cost alongside the quieter V187 option; V120 Small remains the general recommendation.

The directional variant is **0.80% raw / 1.11% EMA lower in mesh response** than its matched whole-response control. Its quiet spatial RMS is **0.038–0.078% lower**, improving30/32 inputs in each state, but both directional EMA quiet means remain above V187. Balancing angular response pressure alone has not produced the requested fine-detail/clean-flat combination.

[Five-state native viewer](images/v195-directional-response-v1/native-viewer.html) · [Full source/ROI/noise/checkpoint manifest](images/v195-directional-response-v1/manifest-v1.json) · [All122 metric rows /732 numeric cells](results/v195-directional-response-v1/metrics-table-v1.csv) · [Final evidence](results/v195-response-final-v1.json).

## Controlled change

Both arms start from the same completed V187 EMA full model, with its trained508-parameter readout and all189 inherited V183 EMA tensors frozen. They use identical fresh head Adam/EMA clocks0, seeds,1,000 cached rows,900 noisy updates,3,600 images,100 ADC skips, domain weights, LR schedule, clipping and all nine previous terms/masks. No neural source changes occur. This is a new matched stage from trained weights; old Adam moments and uninterrupted old EMA history are not claimed.

Whole control adds0.25 domain-weight coherent response to the existing0.25, for total0.50. Directional retains the original0.25 and adds0.25 times the mean response penalty in eight Fourier regions. Equal nominal added weights do not imply equal gradient norms. Targets enter only after inference. [Loss math, CPU/GPU admission and preparation](directional-pair-response.md) · [Completed training/state audit](results/v195-response-training-completed-v1.json).

## Measured tradeoff

RMS values below are camera-RGB DN16. Higher response/gain means more target-aligned modulation; lower error means less error. Each row uses identical cases across all methods. Mesh rows include256 present or256 absent inputs; quiet rows16 each; fresh-flat rows24 noisy inputs per ISO. Each photographic cohort/variant has32 inputs.

{table}

Whole EMA raises response on177/256 present inputs and lowers mean present full RMS0.300%, improving154/256. Its present-case blank RMS rises0.01925% on all256, and absent-case RMS rises0.01944% on all256. Fresh noisy-flat full RMS rises0.00945–0.01392% on all48; block32 mean changes are mixed and below0.0003%. Thus the new response gain comes with small, widespread off-signal costs.

All four Whole EMA photographic band-response means rise, by0.024–0.118% relative;124/128 individual responses rise. All four relative band-error means also worsen, by0.00258–0.00594%. The native bird, butterfly and wood crops stay soft. A response increase is not a guarantee of a lower reconstruction error or newly recovered crossings.

Raw Whole is closer to V187's quiet/response balance: mesh response+0.497% versus the shared V187 EMA donor, with quiet spatial RMS+0.0063% /+0.0906%. Directional raw has mesh response−0.302%, quiet spatial RMS−0.0314% /+0.0484%. Directional EMA raises mesh response2.872% over the donor, with quiet spatial RMS+0.2984% /+0.2570%. Its fresh-flat means and absent errors are slightly lower than matched Whole EMA but still above V187. These alternatives retain different tradeoffs; no flat-safety improvement over V187 is established.

Earlier useful implementations and their native panels remain available in the [V193 comparison/viewer](large-dense-spectrum-comparison.md) and [current model guide](current-model.md). The new gallery reuses V187 as its immediate baseline instead of copying every historical column.

## The weak crossing direction

The same two predeclared V194 examples receive independent Fourier/spatial checks. These are nearest-recipe-normal spectral regions after full-context affine removal; envelope, harmonic and intersection leakage remains. They are not isolated wire-family amplitudes or population confidence intervals. [Full regional records](results/v195-directional-response-v1/directional-breakdown-result-v1.json).

{direction_table}

For2302 the two regions carry about51.03% /48.97% of GT energy. Whole EMA improves both relative to V187, though the actual grid remains very weak. For2309 the weaker region A carries only14.33% of energy; it stays around4.82% of GT while dominant B is about92%. Whole EMA's whole score rises while its weak-region response falls slightly. Directional EMA changes that weak response only from4.8230% to4.8262% of GT, without convincing new visible crossings. Its whole response is slightly below V187 on this example.

The weak2309 component has a coarser fundamental(period27.69 native pixels), below the unchanged1/16 center-frequency band. The diagnostic regions also contain other content. This points to a measurement/basis limitation worth testing; it does not prove the cause of all missing structure. Loss pressure has not added a new measured frequency.

## Native100% crops

All cells are160×160 native pixels. For the two mesh examples below, source is a cached512px RGGB constructed scene, ROI `[176,176,160,160]`, shot0.00128/read6.5536e−6, display exposure8(+3EV), contrast1. The noise draw, coordinates, WB/matrix and display transform are identical across methods; crop pixels are never resized. Checkpoint and module hashes below distinguish raw and EMA states.

{triplets}

The held-out GFX main scene uses DSCF3879 ISO6400 with DSCF3880 ISO100 f/5.6 as an independent qualitative reference. Sky remains smooth at exposure4; building and foliage detail stay soft, and coarse fence geometry remains clear. The cab scene uses DSCF3842 ISO6400 with DSCF3835 ISO100 f/5.6 and both SOOC JPEGs. Both160px ROIs and both noise profiles are included at exposure16. Aperture, exposure time and moving subjects differ: **ISO100/AHD/JPEG references are qualitative, not exact GT**. Neither new arm shows convincing new fine cab crossings.

![Cab fence ROI1: noisy, V187 EMA, four response states, independent references](images/v195-directional-response-v1/comparison-17.png)

![Cab fence ROI2: noisy, V187 EMA, four response states, independent references](images/v195-directional-response-v1/comparison-18.png)

Stress displays expose broad color mottle and false fine structure in absent meshes, gray fields and quiet portions of step/bar/striped scenes. These remain in all new states. The full gallery contains72 native figures, including24 noisy/restored/GT triplets; all were inspected in18 original-detail sheets. ADC-only bark, fur and planes remain unchanged.

## Reproduction and evidence

{checkpoint_table}

The [checkpoint manifest](images/v195-directional-response-v1/manifest-v1.json) also binds all four strict full-state exports and the V187 EMA donor. Every export has193 state tensors; the trained head has508 parameters in four tensors. The archive records the donor's900 updates, the fresh new head Adam clock and the additional900 updates separately.

Both complete training traces and ten checkpoints pass the independent audit(3,780 inherited tensor comparisons). The four final states cover3,288 evaluation rows, with exact V183/V169 replays,288 ADC outputs,144 native RGB and144 wave encodings,107,544,576 checked native addition channels and556 independent Decimal summary means. All732 current-table cells retain their source values. Eight regional projections pass96 independent sector checks. Browser verification checks480 actual160px captures/36,864,000 RGB channels,96 matched raw/EMA pairs, state-specific hashes, flip controls and navigation.

No new source/noise draws, parent/DINO inference, RAW decode or original/dataz access occur. Both GFX families, JPEGs and siblings remain outside training. Input datasets, parent arrays, older reports and all historical comparison pixels are reused in place. Operational preparation/rendering corrections are preserved in the [timestamped diary](../diary/2026-11-08-13-31-36-response-pressure-quality.md) and machine evidence; the successful prediction pass runs once.
"""
# Keep natural prose readable without altering technical identifiers or hashes.
for old,new in {
    "improving30/32":"improving 30/32", "All122":"All 122", "/732":" / 732",
    "trained508":"trained 508", "all189":"all 189", "clocks0":"clocks 0",
    "seeds,1,000":"seeds, 1,000", ",900 noisy":", 900 noisy", ",3,600":", 3,600", ",100 ADC":", 100 ADC",
    "adds0.25":"adds 0.25", "existing0.25":"existing 0.25", "total0.50":"total 0.50",
    "original0.25":"original 0.25", "adds0.25":"adds 0.25", "times the":"times the",
    "include256":"include 256", "or256":"or 256", "rows16":"rows 16", "rows24":"rows 24",
    "has32":"has 32", "on177/256":"on 177/256", "RMS0.300":"RMS 0.300",
    "improving154/256":"improving 154/256", "rises0.019":"rises 0.019", "all256":"all 256",
    "rises0.009":"rises 0.009", "all48":"all 48", "below0.0003":"below 0.0003",
    "by0.024":"by 0.024", ";124/128":"; 124/128", "by0.00258":"by 0.00258",
    "response+0.497":"response +0.497", "RMS+0.0063":"RMS +0.0063", "/+0.0906":" / +0.0906",
    "response−0.302":"response −0.302", "RMS−0.0314":"RMS −0.0314", "/+0.0484":" / +0.0484",
    "response2.872":"response 2.872", "RMS+0.2984":"RMS +0.2984", "/+0.2570":" / +0.2570",
    "For2302":"For 2302", "about51.03":"about 51.03", "/48.97":" / 48.97",
    "For2309":"For 2309", "only14.33":"only 14.33", "around4.82":"around 4.82", "about92":"about 92",
    "from4.8230":"from 4.8230", "to4.8262":"to 4.8262", "weak2309":"weak 2309",
    "fundamental(period27.69":"fundamental (period 27.69", "unchanged1/16":"unchanged 1/16",
    "Native100%":"Native 100%", "are160":"are 160", "cached512":"cached 512", "shot0.00128":"shot 0.00128",
    "exposure8(+3EV)":"exposure 8 (+3 EV)", "contrast1":"contrast 1", "exposure4":"exposure 4",
    "Both160":"Both 160", "exposure16":"exposure 16", "contains72":"contains 72", "including24":"including 24",
    "in18":"in 18", "has193":"has 193", "has508":"has 508", "donor's900":"donor's 900",
    "additional900":"additional 900", "audit(3,780":"audit (3,780", "cover3,288":"cover 3,288",
    "replays,288":"replays, 288", ",144 native":", 144 native", "and144":"and 144", ",107,544":", 107,544",
    "and556":"and 556", "All732":"All 732", "pass96":"pass 96", "checks480":"checks 480", "actual160":"actual 160",
    "captures/36,864":"captures / 36,864", "channels,96":"channels, 96", "states, with":"states, with",
}.items():
    text = text.replace(old,new)
report.write_text(text)
save(ROOT / "report-bindings-v1.json", {
    "report": ref(report), "main_table": ref(ROOT / "report-core-table-v1.md"),
    "direction_table": ref(ROOT / "report-direction-table-v1.md"),
    "metric_CSV": ref(evidence / "metrics-table-v1.csv"), "cells": cells,
    "main_table_numeric_cells": len(cells)*len(methods),
    "complete_table_rows":len(paired["table_rows"]),"complete_table_numeric_cells":len(paired["table_rows"])*len(methods),
    "source": dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
})
print("Wrote report /",len(cells)*6,"main cells /",len(paired["table_rows"])*6,"CSV cells /eight mesh triplets")
